Vet Clinic Marsa Alam
Together we can make Marsa Alam a better place for animals
We treat stray animals for free, financed through donations and our founders, and offer affordable treatments for pets
Services
TNVR - Trap, Neuter, Vaccinate, Return 
Our team goes catching stray animals for spay/neuter and vaccination against rabies. After their recovery, they are returned to their area.
This is sustainable and humane population management.
Emergencies
We treat sick and injured strays and pets, making sure our local animal population stays healthy.
Vaccinations - against rabies and other illnesses
We vaccinate stray animals against rabies, helping with the WHO "zero by 30" goal to eliminate human fatalities from rabies by 2030 in Egypt.
We offer vaccinations for your pets to protect them from serious preventable diseases.
Pet food and supplies
Our pet shop will open soon, offering you a wide selection of food, toys and other supplies for your dog and cat. Stay tuned for news!
Check-ups, deworming and grooming
We care for your private pets, offering check-ups, vaccinations and deworming to keep them healthy and happy.
Microchipping and Travel Papers
If you want to travel with your pet to Europe, they must be chipped, vaccinated, tested and have the appropriate papers. We assist you along the way.
FAQ
 How do I contact you? 
You best reach us by phone/Whatsapp with the number +20 1070763685, on Facebook or Instagram
 Where is the clinic? 
You find us in Marsa Alam: https://maps.app.goo.gl/mhZpyfTxTYU1jCmE7
 Can I visit the clinic? 
Yes, we are very happy to give you a tour through our clinic!
Please send us a WhatsApp to our clinic phone +201070763685 to arrange your visit.
We speak english, german, french, spanish and arabic, depending on who from the team is around.
 How can I support you? 
If
 you live in Marsa Alam: we really appreciate your hands-on help with 
catching and caring for stray animals, we need you as volunteer!
If
 you plan vaccations in Marsa Alam: if you have some space in your 
luggage, we are happy to take donations in the form of old towels, cat 
and dog treats, elastic bandages, ... Please contact us, we are happy to
 advise you what is needed, or have a look at our amazon.de wishlist
If you want to support us from abroad, we really appreciate your donation, helping us to pay our local vets and staff and buy medication and food for stray animals in Marsa Alam.
 What languages do you speak? 
Our team speaks english, german, arabic, french and spanish. 
But feel free to send us a message in any other language, thanks to Google translate we will get back to you anyway!
 There are a lot of cats/dogs at the hotel where I am staying. What can I do to help them?
Many hotels have a cat/dog population. If you want to help them, please talk to the hotel management about spaying/neutering and vaccinating them to avoid the population growing too big. We are happy to do TNR campaigns in hotels, helping them with a sustainable und humane population control.
Please do not take cats or dogs to your room or feed them at the restaurant. They will get used to it, coming there also after you leave. 
Many guests (and therefore most hotels) do not appreciate cats/dogs 
roaming free in the restaurant and gardens.
If you want to feed them,
 ask the staff where an appropriate feeding place is. Often cats/dogs 
get fed by the kitchen or security staff in a place away from the guest 
areas. Please stick to these areas, as it helps to avoid conflicts with 
other guests.
 I found a stray cat/dog, can you take him in?
We are an animal clinic, offering care for sick and injured animals. We are not a shelter, and have no facilities to house a large number of cats or dogs. We can't keep animals after their recovery, so we unfortunately can't take in healthy stray animals.
 I found an injured cat/dog, can you come and pick him up?
Our field team is daily on the streets, and we are happy to help within the Marsa Alam area. Please send us a WhatsApp with the exact location and as many details as you have. This makes it easier for us to come with the appropriate equipment and find the injured animal as quickly as possible.
 I fell in love with a cat/dog and want to take it home with me. What do I need to do?
To take a cat/dog to Europe, they need to be microchipped, vaccinated, tested and need the correct papers. It takes at least 4 months until an animal is ready to travel and costs about 160 Euro. Please send us a WhatsApp and we will assist you with getting your pet travel-ready. You can also find further information on our adoption page.
 I am coming to Marsa Alam soon, can I bring something? 
If you plan vaccations in Marsa Alam: if you have 
some space in your luggage, we are happy to take donations in the form 
of old towels, cat and dog treats, elastic bandages, ... Please contact 
us, we are happy to advise you what is needed, or have a look at our amazon.de wishlist
 How does the clinic finance the free treatment of stray animals? 
The clinic is funded by donations through a Swiss Foundation. Please find here all options to support us.
Also we are happy to have a growing number of private clients that trust us with their pets. All income from private pets is used to treat stray animals
Our impact in Marsa Alam 
The numbers do not really reflect how this month felt ...September was such a busy month! We saw really horrible bite wounds, poison, animals with fluids around the lungs, a diaphragmatic hernia, car accidents, severe head trauma, an ear hematoma, awfull teeth,... it just didn't end. 😳
And through all of that we were again bottlefeeding two orphaned puppies around the clock 😴
So we ended the month with 77 animals under our roof. We never had so many patients staying with us at once 😳
